description_en: Queries the number of endpoints (EPs) that can be created for reverse access on a VPC NAT gateway
description_zh: 调用VpcDescribeVpcNatGatewayNetworkInterfaceQuota接口查询反向访问VPC NAT当前可以创建的EP个数
name: VpcDescribeVpcNatGatewayNetworkInterfaceQuota

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the resource
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: resource_uid

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC NAT gateway to query
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC NAT gateway to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的VPC NAT网关所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

Quota.description_en: The number of EPs that can be created
